query: A new payment-safety skill has four evals: happy path, invalid amount, missing account, and a planted defect that repeats the invalid-amount case. The skill also owns refund authorization, idempotency, and partial-provider-failure behavior. Finish the eval suite before writing the body.
expected_behavior: Identifies that the repeated invalid-amount planted defect does not add an independent behavior
Adds distinct cases for refund authorization, idempotency, and partial provider failure, with observable gradeable rubrics
Keeps the required happy path, edge case, and failure prevention represented and reaches at least six cases
Adds more than six only if another independent behavior or material risk needs separate evidence
Does not write the skill body until the eval coverage is defined
